decisions.rationale: NOA total income $148,627 is about 11% below the stated $167,000 and the pay stub YTD conflicts with the June 6, 2026 start date, so the shortfall needs escalation.
Chequing balance of $193,409 with about 3 months of history and only payroll and small transfers covers the $161,200 down payment plus closing costs.
Summit Property Valuations (on panel) valued the property at $650,000 against a $645,000 price in a report dated 2026-05-26.
The letter states the applicant started June 6, 2026 and is within a six-month probation, with no exception approval on file.
TDS is about 51.6% ($7,177 of obligations on $13,917 monthly income including the $2,450 car payment), far above the 44% maximum and not marginal for DTI-03.
